about: buildSummaryPrompt (llm.ts) and formatTranscriptForPrompt / captureGapsForPrompt, run by TS (llm.vectors.test.ts) and Rust (crates/qrtz-llm/tests/vectors.rs). Segments are inline or generated (`gen`: segment i has startMs i*stepMs, speakerName speakers[i % n] (null: none), text texts[i % n] repeated `repeat` times plus ' #i'). An expectation longer than 4000 chars is stored as {length (UTF-16 units), sha256 (UTF-8), head, tail}. N69: every prompt case pins opts.fenceNonce; the transcript is fenced in <transcript-NONCE> lines and words, speaker labels and the title have C0/C1 controls, U+2028/2029 and bidi controls replaced by spaces (n69-*). N97: note text is cleaned the same way, one line per note (n97-note-forged-lines).
